description.text: One of the second pair of Scarlet & Violet expansions, released on 14 April 2023 together with Snow Hazard, in which the sealed legendary Pokémon of Paldea are set free. Ting-Lu ex and Chi-Yu ex, two of the four Treasures of Ruin, lead it: Ting-Lu ex's Ability takes away the Abilities of the opponent's Pokémon with damage counters on them, other than Pokémon ex. Tinkaton ex, whose attack does more damage the more cards its player holds, Bellibolt ex, Noivern ex and the Tera Pokémon Forretress ex join them, with the first card of the gym leader Iono and the Supporter Saguaro. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Ting-Lu ex, Superior Energy Retrieval and basic Grass Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Paldea Evolved in June 2023.
